question_text: Under Article IX of the 1987 Constitution, the Civil Service Commission (CSC), the Commission on Elections (COMELEC), and the Commission on Audit (COA) are granted fiscal autonomy. Which of the following best explains the purpose of this fiscal autonomy?

options.text: It allows these commissions to set their own budgets without any oversight from Congress.
It ensures that these commissions are independent from the executive branch by giving them control over their own appropriations.
It allows these commissions to collect taxes and generate their own revenues.
It exempts these commissions from the auditing rules of the COA.
